title: Add auditor and warden roles per the 2026-10-16 BRIEF addendum
summary: Implement the 2026-10-16 BRIEF addendum: an auditor role that judges real outcomes against BRIEF.md and owner goals, and a warden role plus landing check that holds any landing touching protected files or weakening a check. Follows the audience-role pattern (role, core module, CLI, tests, design doc), for the owner.

defaults_applied.how: Tests, clippy and fmt criteria included.
Criteria check holds happening on real landing scenarios.
Protection enforced by a warden check in code, not prose.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: the owner (and anyone judging Athena's trustworthiness) gets in-house grading with a protected yardstick, per the 2026-10-16 addendum in BRIEF.md.
Modeled on how the audience role was added: role definition in roles.rs, core module, CLI command, tests, design doc.
Warden is a mechanical check on landings (protected paths, loosened checks) plus a role definition; it holds rather than rejects.
No athena.toml/defaults.toml/workflow change is needed; protected list lives in code. If the list must live in athena.toml, that would need owner action.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test`: tests pass showing a landing that modifies BRIEF.md, an auditor/warden prompt, a grader prompt or threshold, or a permission/budget/kill-switch setting is held with a recorded reason, while an ordinary landing still lands.
Run `cargo test`: a test shows a landing that deletes a test or lowers a threshold (loosens a check) is held.
Run `cargo test`: a test shows a job's change to the auditor's or warden's prompts or checks is held.
Run `cargo test`: an auditor run through the fake agent records a verdict citing evidence of a real outcome, judged against BRIEF.md and owner goals.
Run `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check`: both clean; `cargo test` passes overall.

crates/athena-data/src/roles.rs defines valid `auditor` and `warden` RoleDefinitions with short fixed prompts and tests; the auditor prompt says to judge against BRIEF.md and owner goals, not the job's criteria, and to look at real outcomes rather than records.
The protected list is defined in exactly one place in code, and a design doc plus CHANGELOG entry explain both roles, the list, alternatives considered, and that only the owner changes these rules.

out_of_scope: Changing BRIEF.md, athena.toml, defaults.toml, or CI workflows
Changing existing graders' prompts or thresholds
Scheduled or automatic auditor runs beyond a CLI command
departures: Larger than the reference: a new role, a landing gate, a CLI command, and tests across several crates.
